svg.title: Ember Relay v2 — original side-view map design
svg.desc: Uneven ground above two underground chambers, nine staggered floating platforms, four upper connections, two true fall corridors and a wide lower staging island. Coordinates match the implementation brief. Design schematic, not tested gameplay.

g.text: 02 / UNEVEN GROUND · EXPOSED LANDINGS · REAL FALLS
Original 2D side-view design • 3200 × 1900 world units • 35 solids • native body 36 × 68 • no movement or fuel retuning
Review schematic only. Route arrows show connections, not simulated trajectories. S0/B0 active; other markers are candidate test data.
No continuous aerial roof or lower safety floor
Dashed bottom = recovery when living body TOP passes Y1900. V1/V2 remain open below Y1050; resources and scores are retained.
A missed landing can reach a void.
Drop in; staged return via U12.
Narrow lip; M3 is more forgiving.
Stand in rooms or jet over roofs.
Surface lips hide part of the body.
C01 shields the supported initial spawn.
Ordinary jumps work in ideal arithmetic.
The voids continue below both breaks.
No death penalty or tuning change.
DESIGN REVIEW • Original authored coordinates • No MM layout reuse • Range / Host / Join preserved • Offline first playable only
Playtest next: narrow landing control, slope jumps, shaft undersides, low-fuel decisions and whether the lower route feels useful.
